rationale: The claim involves a rear-end collision that totaled the policyholder's vehicle, with injuries sustained, clearly falling under the auto claim type covered by the active auto_full policy.
claim_summary: Policyholder Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended at a red light on Route 9 at ~8:15 AM by a driver traveling ~35 mph who did not brake. The vehicle is totaled (trunk crushed into back seat), and Pat sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. The other driver's insurance information is available on the police report. This is a high-severity auto claim requiring prompt adjuster follow-up on both the total loss and the injury assessment.

case_facts.description: Claimant was rear-ended by another driver traveling ~35 mph who did not brake. Entire trunk crushed into back seat.
case_facts.vehicle_condition: Car is totaled — trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.injuries: Claimant has whiplash and a sprained wrist
case_facts.third_party_info: Other driver's insurance info on police report
